ExecutionBlockRef.title: executionBlockRef
ExecutionBlockRef.description: A block reference for a method that executes against the block rather than reading it. It is the same object as `blockRef`, except that `blockNumber` may be given in decimal as well as in hex: the height is resolved by `ExecutionBlockRetriever`, which parses both bases, where the reading methods go through `Web3InformationRetriever` and take hex only. At least one of `blockHash` or `blockNumber` must be present; the node rejects an object carrying neither with `Invalid block input`.

blockNumber.title: executionBlockNumber
blockNumber.description: The block's height, in hex or in decimal
